import numpy as np


def cashflows(perf, terms):
    perf = np.asarray(perf, dtype=float)
    n_paths = perf.shape[0]
    n_dates = perf.shape[1]
    cash = np.zeros((n_paths, n_dates), dtype=float)
    notional = float(terms["notional"])
    final_index = int(terms["final_index"])
    worst = np.min(perf, axis=2)
    alive = np.ones(n_paths, dtype=bool)
    autocall = terms["autocall"]
    coupon = terms["coupon"]
    unpaid = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=float)
    for k in range(n_dates):
        if k == final_index:
            continue
        if coupon is not None:
            amounts = coupon["amounts"]
            if amounts[k] is not None:
                amount = float(amounts[k])
                barrier = float(coupon["barrier"])
                due = alive & (worst[:, k] >= barrier)
                if bool(coupon["memory"]):
                    cash[due, k] += amount + unpaid[due]
                    unpaid[due] = 0.0
                    missed = alive & (worst[:, k] < barrier)
                    unpaid[missed] += amount
                else:
                    cash[due, k] += amount
        if autocall is not None:
            call_amounts = autocall["call_amounts"]
            if call_amounts[k] is not None:
                trigger = float(autocall["trigger"])
                called = alive & (worst[:, k] >= trigger)
                cash[called, k] += float(call_amounts[k])
                alive[called] = False
    if coupon is not None:
        amounts = coupon["amounts"]
        if amounts[final_index] is not None:
            amount = float(amounts[final_index])
            barrier = float(coupon["barrier"])
            due = alive & (worst[:, final_index] >= barrier)
            if bool(coupon["memory"]):
                cash[due, final_index] += amount + unpaid[due]
            else:
                cash[due, final_index] += amount
    final_perf = worst[:, final_index]
    upside_return = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=float)
    upside = terms["upside"]
    if upside is not None:
        leverage = float(upside["leverage"])
        upside_return = leverage * np.maximum(final_perf - 1.0, 0.0)
        if upside["cap"] is not None:
            upside_return = np.minimum(upside_return, float(upside["cap"]))
    maturity = notional * (1.0 + upside_return)
    maturity = np.maximum(maturity, notional)
    cash[alive, final_index] += maturity[alive]
    return cash
